text:
deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK executed for release v2.7.1 -> pinned v2.6.9 on dedicated pool us-west-2-ded-3. Trigger: p95 latency > 750ms for 10m. Reason: latency-regression. :rotating_light:

maria_prod: saw the alert, joining. did customer traffic drop or just internal SLOs?

simon_infra: mostly internal; kvcache miss rate jumped. stack traces show higher memory churn on 2.7.1 quant path.

tyler_sre: confirm automated rollback happened at 1834123420? need to check canary window overlap.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated at 1834123420 by policy "canary-latency-fallback". Canary traffic was 12% on that pool.

janet_pm: any active Dedicated customers in that pool who could be impacted by version pin? I have one named BitHelm that reported intermittent errors earlier this week.

simon_infra: BitHelm is on that pool, yes. They were on v2.7.0 but we rolled them forward in the canary. We pinned back to 2.6.9, which is compatible with their pinned config but we should notify.

lia_support: drafting outbound now. proposed message: "We're investigating an automated safety rollback affecting model versions in your dedicated pool; you may see transient failures while we confirm stability. We'll update in 30m." ok to send?

maria_prod: send after we confirm no live exec actions are needed. lia, include link to status page and escalation path. add: "No action needed on your side unless you experience persistent errors; contact us at support@redwood.ai"

alex_dev: to be safe, let's hold further rollouts to that pool. command to block: ```/deploy block-pool --pool us-west-2-ded-3 --until 1834127200 --reason "investigating kvcache regression"```

tyler_sre: running the block now and enabling extra tracing. Also kicking off a hotfix branch to revert the quantization change that landed in 2.7.1.

simon_infra: quick mitigation: re-enable prefix caching and drop the new kernel selector for the affected population. I'll open a patch in infra runtime.

janet_pm: communications plan: (1) notify BitHelm AEs + account owner, (2) post a short note in status.redwood.ai, (3) message general release channel with summary. I'll take #1. lia take #2, maria take #3.

lia_support: posted status page update: "Investigating automated rollback in us-west-2 dedicated pool; some customers may see brief disruptions. Engineering is on it." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-18341

maria_prod: posted to #releases: short summary + link to status. tagged @eng-oncall and @sales-leads.

alex_dev: telemetry note: saving current heap dumps to s3://redwood-debug/usw2/dump-1834123430.tar.gz before any binaries change.

tyler_sre: thanks. priority: confirm rollback restored p95 < 400ms. if not, escalate to manual failover to alternate pool us-west-2-ded-1.

simon_infra: initial metrics: p95 back to ~380ms after rollback. continuing to monitor for 15m.

janet_pm: lia, can you notify BitHelm that we've rolled them back proactively and will keep them posted? mention potential follow-up maintenance window for a proper fix.

lia_support: message sent to BitHelm CSM and account team. copied legal and security per dedicated-customer playbook.

maria_prod: ok good. once we have 30m stable metrics we'll allow canary to proceed or we'll escalate patch. keep this thread for updates. nothing else from product side. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: follow-up reminder scheduled at 1834125200 to re-evaluate rollback state and lift pool block if safe.

simon_infra: logging final note: root cause suspected in new quantization kernel selector interacting with prefix caching; working patch MR: mr/infra/quant-fallback-1834. will request emergency review.

tyler_sre: if the patch is small we can canary it to ded-1 then ded-3. otherwise plan is longer rollback window + customer maintenance.

lia_support: last update to BitHelm: "We've applied a safety rollback to the version you were briefly rolled forward to; you should see normal behavior. We'll coordinate maintenance for a proper fix. Contact support if issues persist"

simon_infra: monitoring green for 20m. closing interim incident if still stable at 1834123950.

maria_prod: thanks everyone. will write short postmortem draft after we stabilize with timeline and comms.
